content: We refer to the remaining subset of the New York Times data after filtering as the LGBTQ corpus. The LGBTQ corpus consists of 93,977 paragraphs and 7.36 million tokens. However, a large increase in reporting on LGBTQ-related issues has led to a highly skewed distribution in the amount of data over years, with 1986 containing the least data (1144 paragraphs and 73,549 tokens) and 2012 containing the most (5924 paragraphs and 465,254 tokens).
